headline: Ligabue closes his tour at Unipol Dome (up to 16,000); ICARE congress ends at MiCo
taxi: Santa Giulia / Rogoredo from ~23:00 (red zone around the Dome); CityLife departures early afternoon.
linate: Congress doctors leaving MiCo in the afternoon; otherwise a normal Saturday.

headline: Inter – Fiorentina at San Siro, 12:30 kick-off (~70,000)
taxi: San Siro / Lotto from ~11:00 and again 14:30–15:30. Clocks went back one hour overnight.
linate: Sunday-evening returns; Fiorentina fans mostly by road and rail.

headline: EXPOdetergo last day at Rho; otherwise a normal Monday
taxi: Business rides from Rho Fiera around closing.

headline: No major events; trade visitors arrive for MiCo fairs
linate: Tuesday-evening arrivals for Lift Expo, VISCOM and Paint & Coatings.

headline: AC Milan – Bologna at 18:30 (~60,000) plus four trade shows at MiCo
taxi: West side squeezed: San Siro arrivals 17–18:30 overlap MiCo closing; exits 20:30–21:30.
linate: Trade visitors fly in Tue evening / Wed morning.

headline: MiCo fairs continue; rail strike starts at 21:00
taxi: CityLife at opening and closing; late evening, stations (Centrale, Garibaldi) as trains start to be cancelled.
linate: Moderate business traffic; some rail travellers switch to flights.

headline: USB general strike (taxis listed, ATM excluded) on the derby-weekend Friday
taxi: Possible fewer taxis while metro runs normally; demand at stations if trains are cancelled (Trenord guaranteed 6–9, 18–21).
linate: Flights protected by the 30 Oct–5 Nov franchise; Friday departures plus fans arriving for the derby.

headline: Derby AC Milan – Inter at 20:45 (~75,000) on Halloween night
taxi: San Siro 22:45–00:30, then centre nightlife until late: the busiest night of the week.
linate: Long weekend (All Saints, Sun 1 Nov): Saturday departures and arrivals.
